prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets", "Signing in ensures your desktop companions are safely saved to your account and synced across devices.", "Cloud Pet Saver Active"]
1: ["Customize Your Companion", "Adjust personality traits and preview your pet before completing adoption.", "Select Personality"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Engine...", "Granting desktop overlay permissions..."]
3: ["Your Companion is Live on Desktop!", "Learn these basic desktop shortcuts to interact with your new pet anytime.", "Shortcut Guide: Alt+P to summon, Right-Click to hide, Double-Click to chat."]
4: ["Select Your Journey", "Pick how you want to create or adopt your desktop friend.", "Recommended for Quick Setup"]
5: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Well-lit photos ensure your custom 3D desktop pet generates accurately.", "Ensure clear lighting and face visibility for optimal generation quality.", "High Resolution Recommended"]
6: ["Hatching Your Pet...", "Check your taskbar or notification center if your pet doesn't display immediately.", "Desktop Display Ready"]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary", "Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray to toggle desktop overlay anytime.", "Start Playing"]
8: ["Secure Your Pets & Cloud Save", "Sign in now to back up your custom pets and preserve all progress across app restarts.", "Already have an account? Sign in to restore your existing desktop pets."]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your companion is officially registered and bound to your desktop.", "Official Pet Sanctuary Seal"]
